Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, sr As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, -2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 0.5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    Set sr = ch.SeriesCollection(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        s = sr.InvertIfNegative
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.InvertIfNegative = True
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.InvertIfNegative = True: sr.InvertIfNegative = False
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = xlBarClustered
        sr.InvertIfNegative = True
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        s = sr.InvertIfNegative
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        sr.InvertIfNegative = True
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        s = sr.Explosion
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        sr.Explosion = 25
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        sr.Explosion = 0
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        sr.Explosion = 400
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        sr.Explosion = 401
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        sr.Explosion = -1
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = xlDoughnut
        sr.Explosion = 10
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        s = sr.Explosion
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        sr.Explosion = 10
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        s = ch.HasDataTable
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.HasDataTable = True
    Case 17
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.HasDataTable = True: ch.HasDataTable = False
    Case 18
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        ch.HasDataTable = True
    Case 19
        ch.ChartType = xlPie
        ch.HasDataTable = True
    Case 20
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        s = ch.Name
    Case 21
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Parent.Name = "Sales": s = ch.Name
    Case 22
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        ch.Name = "X"
    End Select
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 22
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
